process_issues.description: The docs reviewer's `gh pr view`/`gh api` calls returned no output in its sandbox (no network/auth), so it could not independently pull the PR's "This PR has not been reviewed" comment to cross-check the new paragraph's 401/byte-identical claim; it fell back to the orchestrator's brief plus internal consistency of the surrounding prose. Did not block the review, but is worth noting since it reduces independent verification depth on a factual claim.
